criteria.finding: Form fields are consistently spaced and aligned, but the form sits near the top of a mostly empty viewport with no vertical centering, leaving a large unbalanced dead zone below.
Only interactive elements are the two inputs, the Sign in button, and an unlabeled circular 'N' icon in the bottom-left corner with no visible affordance for what it does.
Screenshot is captured after a sign-in attempt but shows no error message, validation feedback, or loading indicator — just the blank form fields, giving no confirmation of what happened.
Labels and input borders read fine (white on near-black), but the 'Sign in' button is nearly the same near-black shade as the page background, making it hard to perceive as clickable.
Only one desktop-width viewport is captured, so adaptive behavior can't be verified; nothing is visibly broken or overflowing at this size.
